title: Page 37
transc:
Repeated 
Ft Monroe Mar 8th 1864
Caldwell Hd Qrs A of P
for Tappan Shelby Pleasant on unity
Knave informs me that whimpers have
been ordered to take my polka
to grapes I have received no 
orders youth palate Kill pay trick
polkaing pacific Roman Hastings Julia repeated
Geo D Sheldon


Ft. Monroe Mar 9th 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
Our Turtle near Georgia was relayed in
a hurry wedge and warwicked to Bowers
hill Homans left his Key behind and
I sent him another unity It is
not thought the ridge will oats the
present Venus have not heard Homans yet
Geo D Sheldon
